role: Classification query executor for the Co-Being knowledge graph — answers 'is X a Y?' through IS_A hierarchy traversal
detail: Implements proc:classification_query ProceduralTemplate using bounded BFS traversal of IS_A chains from subject to target ancestors. Key classes: ClassificationQueryExecutor (main executor with async execute() method), ClassificationQueryRequest (subject/target node_ids + session/correlation tracking), ClassificationQueryResult (boolean is_classified + confidence + reasoning_chain). Confidence propagation formula: chain_product * (0.95^n_hops) where 0.95 per-hop matches IS_A transitivity axiom. Min confidence floor 0.3 prunes branches. Cycle detection via visited-node set prevents infinite loops. Developmental gating (Piaget D4): unlocks after 25 successful definitions + 3 concept clusters + 15 guardian confirmations; thresholds stored in rule:classification_gate_config EvolutionRule. Max traversal depth configurable (default 5, from rule:classification_depth_config). CANON A.1/A.10/A.11/A.12/A.19/A.20 compliance enforced. Records SemanticInferenceTrace on every query.
gotchas: DENOTES bridge traversal is selective (only when IS_A edges absent) per A.20 boundary respect. Neo4j queries catch exceptions and log warnings but return empty/zero defaults rather than propagating — queries may silently fail. BFS explores all parents at each depth level before going deeper for shortest path (highest confidence). Cycle detection logs warning but continues traversal (doesn't error). Guardian override flag in gate_config allows bypassing all gating checks.
